Contributor: iandees Discussion Comment No.: 1 Comment: Hello! I noticed that node https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/3112167062 was moved a long distance in this changeset. This is a common mistake that happens when you click on a point and drag to move the map. The point moves with your mouse instead of the map. I moved things back to where they were before in https://www.openstreetmap.org/changeset/180602492, so no harm done! To avoid this in the future: - Try to click on an empty part of the map when you want to move around - If you see a point move by mistake, press Ctrl+Z (or Cmd+Z on Mac) to undo it Happy mapping!
